evidence.description: USBD register definitions in vendor/N32901-3_NonOS_BSP/SYSLIB/Lib/W55FA93_reg.h show USBD_BA+0x178 (EPF_HEAD_CNT) then USBD_BA+0x700 (AHB_DMA_ADDR) and +0x704 (PHY_CTL); no +0x190/+0x2B0 offsets defined.

summary: In vendor BSP W55FA93_reg.h, USBD_BA register definitions cover offsets up to EPF_HEAD_CNT (+0x178) and then jump to AHB_DMA_ADDR (+0x700) and PHY_CTL (+0x704). There are no USBD register definitions at +0x190 or +0x2B0, so absolute addresses 0x00008190/0x000082B0 seen in APP.bin are not USBD_BA offsets and likely point into RAM or other data structures.
title: BSP USBD register map has no +0x190/+0x2B0 offsets
